description: Pulses its output for one pass when a matching system event arrived, for example a pin edge, an over-current alert or a motor fault. The value of the event goes to the output.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled. An event lives exactly one pass: one that arrives while the block is disabled is missed.

eno.description: A one-pass pulse on the pass in which a matching event arrived. To hold it (event, then wait, then act), put a Latch below it.

outputs.description: The value of the event. Several matches in one pass collapse into one pulse: the value is the last one's.

fields.description: The device that raised the event. Any: every device.
What happened. The events a device can raise depend on its contracts (IO, power, H-bridge). Any: every event of that device.
The pin or channel of that device the event came from. Any: every one.
